etranger.feats.title: All of Galac6, for your school, wherever it is
etranger.f1.t: The French curriculum, as it is
etranger.f1.d: From CP to Terminale, the same topics and the same exams as in France. An AI tutor built on sound teaching methods guides each pupil step by step, without giving away the answer.
etranger.f2.d: Dictations read aloud and marked, paper copies scanned then marked, quizzes ready in a few minutes. The time saved goes back to teaching.
etranger.f3.d: You see what each pupil has mastered and where they struggle. You know who to help, and with what.
etranger.f4.d: Your pupils practise on official past papers, including those set outside France, as mock exams with detailed marking.
etranger.f5.d: Your classes, their averages and the topics to work on again, brought together in a space for the leadership team.
etranger.f6.d: Import your pupil list from a file exported from Pronote or École Directe, or from a simple pasted list. No need to enter them one by one.
etranger.f7.d: Emails to families are sent in French or in English, as your school chooses.
etranger.f8.d: Automatic messages follow your school's local time, not Paris time.
etranger.f9.d: Data is hosted in France, in the European Union, and processed in line with the GDPR. It is never sold.

etranger.faq.title: Your questions
etranger.faq.q1: Do we need to adapt Galac6 to our school?
etranger.faq.a1: No. Galac6 follows the official French curriculum, from CP to Terminale, the same as in your school. Your teachers find the topics, levels and exams they already know.
etranger.faq.q2: How do we add our pupils?
etranger.faq.a2: You import your pupil list from a file: an export from Pronote or École Directe, or a simple pasted list. No need to enter them one by one.
etranger.faq.q3: Not all our families read French. What can we do?
etranger.faq.a3: Emails to families are sent in French or in English, as your school chooses, and at your school's local time.
etranger.faq.a4: Data is hosted in France, in Paris, and Galac6's main artificial intelligence is processed in Europe. Only the pupil's teachers and their school's leadership can see their work. Full details are on the pupil data page (in French).
etranger.faq.a5: The pilot is free for 3 months for 3 classes, with no commitment. After that, we send you a quote in euros based on the number of your pupils and the modules chosen.
etranger.form.lead: Tell us in a few lines who you are. We will reply with a pilot proposal, a demo or a quote in euros.
etranger.f.email.err: Enter a full email address, for example firstname.lastname@lycee-francais.org.
etranger.side.next.l3: We launch the pilot for 3 classes, then you receive a quote in euros.

expat.feats.title: Everything your child needs to stay on track, far from France
expat.f1.t: The French curriculum, from CP to Terminale
expat.f1.d: Galac6 follows the official French curriculum in the main subjects. Your child revises exactly what they study, or what they would study in France.
expat.f2.t: An AI tutor that makes pupils think
expat.f2.d: Galac6's AI tutor is didactic: it guides your child step by step, with questions and hints, without doing the work for them.
expat.f3.d: Over 2,000 dictations read aloud and marked mistake by mistake, with the rule explained. Spelling and grammar stay sharp, even far from France.
expat.f4.t: The brevet and bac from abroad
expat.f4.d: Over 400 official past papers, including 112 set outside France, as timed mock exams with detailed marking.
expat.f5.d: Quizzes, exercises, mental maths and revision sheets on every topic, at any time, whatever the time difference.
expat.f6.d: Your child's data is hosted in France, processed in line with the GDPR, and never sold.
expat.cned.title: Galac6 and the CNED: two different roles
expat.cned.p1: Galac6 is not a distance-learning school: it does not replace schooling and does not award diplomas. If your child is not enrolled at a French school, official distance learning from the French Ministry of Education is provided by the CNED.
expat.cned.p2: Galac6 is a complement, whatever your child's schooling: to understand lessons, practise, revise for tests and prepare for exams.
expat.stats.title: French and exams, practised from abroad
expat.stats.s2.l: official brevet and bac past papers, including over 250 in maths

expat.faq.title: Your questions
expat.faq.q1: Does Galac6 follow the French curriculum, even from abroad?
expat.faq.a1: Yes. Galac6 follows the official French curriculum, from CP to Terminale, whatever country you live in. It does not follow any other country's curriculum.
expat.faq.q2: Does Galac6 replace the CNED or a school?
expat.faq.a2: No. Galac6 is a complement: it helps your child understand, practise and revise. Official distance learning, with enrolment and follow-up by teachers, is the role of the CNED.
expat.faq.q3: Can my child prepare for the brevet or bac from abroad?
expat.faq.a3: Yes. They practise on official brevet, French bac and maths bac past papers, including 112 set outside France, as mock exams with detailed marking. Galac6 does not handle exam registration.
expat.faq.q4: My child goes to a local school. Can Galac6 help them keep up their French?
expat.faq.a4: Yes. Dictations read aloud and marked, homework help in French and quizzes help them keep strong written French. The content follows the levels of the French curriculum.
expat.faq.a5: To try it, the Discovery plan gives access to every feature in limited amounts, each month. For all of Galac6 without limits: the Student plan at €69 a year or €7.99 a month, and the Family plan, for up to 4 children, at €99 a year or €11.99 a month.

meta.dictee.description: Over 2,000 French dictations read aloud and marked mistake by mistake, with the rule explained. For pupils on the French curriculum, at home or in class.
meta.dictee.og_title: Galac6: French dictation online, read aloud and marked
meta.dictee.og_description: Your child listens, writes, then every mistake is marked with the rule. Over 2,000 dictations, from CP to lycée.
dictee.hero.title: French dictation online, read aloud and marked
dictee.hero.sub: Galac6 reads the dictation aloud. Your child writes it down, then every mistake is marked with the rule that explains it. From CP to lycée, without you having to dictate.
dictee.hero.g1: Over 2,000 dictations, written and checked for every level.
dictee.hero.g2: Read aloud, at home or in class.
dictee.hero.g3: Marking that explains every mistake, without punishing.
dictee.steps.title: A dictation in four steps
dictee.s1.d: Your child picks their class: Galac6 offers a suitable dictation, from CP to lycée.
dictee.s2.d: Galac6 reads the text aloud, as a parent or teacher would.
dictee.s3.d: Your child writes on screen, or on paper and then takes a photo of the page.
dictee.s4.d: Every mistake is reviewed one by one, with the matching rule, so it is not made again.
dictee.feats.title: Checked texts, precise marking
dictee.f1.d: Dictations written and checked for every class from CP to 3e, and extracts from great public-domain authors up to Terminale.
dictee.f2.d: Spelling, agreements, homophones, conjugation and punctuation: the marking spots each type of mistake.
dictee.f3.d: For every mistake, the correct spelling and the rule, explained simply. Your child understands why, which helps avoid making the mistake again.
dictee.f4.d: No need to look for a text or dictate it yourself: your child practises alone, at their own pace, and sees their progress.
dictee.f5.d: Each pupil takes the dictation alone on screen, in class or at home, and gets tailored dictations built on their own mistakes. Paper copies are scanned, then marked.
dictee.f6.d: French spelling is the same everywhere: the dictations also help children living outside France keep up their French.

dictee.faq.title: Your questions about dictation
dictee.faq.q1: Are the dictations really read aloud?
dictee.faq.a1: Yes. Galac6 reads every dictation aloud: your child listens and writes it down, without an adult having to dictate.
dictee.faq.a2: Galac6 compares the copy with the text, reviews every mistake one by one and explains the rule to apply: agreement, homophone, conjugation, spelling or punctuation.
dictee.faq.a3: From CP to 3e, with dictations written for every class, and up to Terminale with extracts from great public-domain authors. The dictations follow the French curriculum.
dictee.faq.q4: Can teachers give a dictation to their class?
dictee.faq.a4: Yes. Each pupil takes the dictation alone on screen, and Galac6 suggests the marking and the grade: the teacher has the final say. Paper copies can be scanned, then marked.
dictee.faq.q5: How much does online dictation cost?
dictee.faq.a5: The Discovery plan includes one dictation a month to try it. The Student plan (€69 a year or €7.99 a month) and the Family plan (€99 a year or €11.99 a month, up to 4 children) give unlimited dictations. For schools, pricing is on quote.

annales.faq.title: Your questions about past papers
annales.faq.q1: Are the past papers real papers?
annales.faq.a1: Yes. They are official papers from the French Ministry of Education, with their original questions and mark schemes. No AI-generated paper is ever presented as a past paper.
annales.faq.a2: No. The marking is written by Galac6's AI, question by question, from the original mark scheme. It explains mistakes and gives advice, but it is not an official answer key.
annales.faq.a3: Yes: 112 official brevet, French bac and maths bac papers set outside France, useful for pupils at French schools abroad.
annales.faq.a4: The four written exams: maths, French, science and history-geography-civics. Pupils can sit the whole exam or just one part.
annales.faq.a5: The Discovery plan includes one brevet or bac style paper each month to try it. The Exam Pack (€19, or €14 with an annual subscription) adds full mock exams. The Student and Family plans open all of Galac6 without limits.
